scope: Read-only independent full alignment review of all six stages, complete task/reference/contract/rubric/review and all seven mathematical modules. Actual declarations, proof bodies and representation bridges were read independently of the author mapping. Compiler evidence is separate.

items.analysis: Actual real matrix units imply the Gram matrix is positive definite. The native CFC square root is proved positive definite, symmetric and commuting with every E_i. normalize_root constructs the actual unit U=V D inverse and proves orthogonality, all intertwinings and equality U inverse V=D. Omitting idempotence/completeness in this stronger theorem does not strengthen any task assumption.

Near is actual entrywise ideal congruence with an explicit quotient-ring equivalence. The inverse of 4 is constructed from the supplied unit 2. T=(1/4)(I−G) lies in I. The denominator-free Catalan iteration has adjacent errors in I^n, is Cauchy in the actual ideal filtration, and scalar completeness constructs every entry of its matrix limit. Equality modulo every ideal power proves its fixed-point identity, symmetry and every commutation relation. D=I−2TC is a genuine square root of G; normalize_root gives an actual invertible near-identity orthogonal intertwiner. This is a complete alternative proof authorized by the contract; no desired convergence/root is assumed.

An actual subgroup of matrix units imposes orthogonality, near-identity congruence and every centralizer equation simultaneously. All closure laws are proved. For a given actual solution U0, the comparison subtype and subgroup have an actual two-sided Equiv U↦U0 inverse U, H↦U0 H. This proves both coverage and unique parameter without asserting existence when U0 is unavailable.

Native Z_2 carries proved DVR, characteristic-zero and adic-complete instances. The supplied 2x2 P,Q,V and explicit inverse satisfy every complete symmetric decomposition and congruence/intertwining requirement. Any matrix satisfying orthogonality and intertwining has first column b=2a and 5a^2=1, contradicted by the actual reduction ring homomorphism to ZMod 8. All matrices are excluded; the proof is stronger than excluding a scalar normalization.

The hypothesis V≡I mod8 yields an actual entrywise matrix W with V=I+8W. The actual Gram formula gives B=W transpose+W+8 W transpose W; cancellation of the nonzero scalar 8 proves B centralizes every E_i. T=−2B belongs to the maximal ideal, is symmetric and centralizing. The already proved integral Catalan iteration supplies the genuine root and unit U with all desired conditions. No inverse of 2, reference binomial convergence certificate or stronger congruence is assumed.

For every even c the actual denominator is proved a unit, and P,Q,V plus inverse form genuine ComparisonData with complete complementary decompositions. Any orthogonal intertwiner yields b=ca and (1+c^2)a^2=1. The finite ZMod8 theorem is transported through actual reduction to ZMod4, and the exact kernel theorem gives c∈4Z_2, excluding every U. For c=4k, T=−4k^2 I belongs to the maximal ideal, and the proved integral adic iteration constructs a matrix root of the actual Gram matrix; normalize_root then constructs U. The iff theorem covers all parameters. S3 supplies all solutions after existence, without adding assumptions to the classification.
